messages:
Elaine (Design): dropped a compact rules list mock. trying a smaller reorder handle + condensed copy. screenshot: https://img.redwood/snap/compact-reorder.png
Taylor (Eng): looks clean. concern: mobile/touch targets—need >=44px hit area.
Jisoo (Design Ops): can visually shrink the handle and keep invisible padding for taps. show drag affordance only on hover/focus to reduce clutter.
Samir (PM): copy suggestion for priority conflict: 'Conflict: two rules share priority — reorder or change numbers' rather than 'Duplicate priority detected'.
Morgan (Accessibility): VoiceOver reads the handle as 'button' only. add aria-label: 'Reorder rule: <title>' and keyboard support (space/enter to grab, arrows to move). also use aria-grabbed and announce states. focus ring contrast must be >=3:1.
Taylor (Eng): implementation plan: keep visual handle small, extend hitarea with container padding, add tabindex and keydown handlers, set role=button, aria-label, aria-grabbed, and live region updates for preview status.
Elaine (Design): i'll update mocks: tooltip on focus to reveal full title, thicker focus ring, and two label variants for preview button for hallway test.
deploy-bot: branch created reorder/a11y-handle CI queued.
deploy-bot: CI passed for reorder/a11y-handle — build 52342.
Samir (PM): action items: Taylor add a11y handlers in PR; Elaine update mocks; Morgan quick a11y review after PR; Jisoo update i18n keys. react :thumbsup: if you agree with copy changes, :eyes: if you want to review the PR.
Elaine (Design): :thumbsup:
